violations.reason: The coverage audit report for Moodle Integration claims 0 gaps, but completely fails to address the first client brief requirement regarding 401 Unauthorized errors and failing CI tests.
The PR submits an automated review verdict approving PR #0 with an empty criticalReason, acting as a pipeline stage faking success (a hardcoded fixture response).
The task plan completely lacks a Definition of Done (DoD) mentioning error patterns (400, 401, 403 or error), which is explicitly required by the BARCAN-TAG-07 charter.

The task plan sets coverageComplete to true despite only planning for token header transmission, thereby dropping the majority of the Moodle integration spec (role sync, autonomous fallback, etc.) and faking success.
